proposals.evidence: The plain nakha branch lists Punjabi/Lahnda naũh, Dogri nɛ̃, western Pahari nā and Maithili nah/nauh, reflecting loss of the velar and often nasalization. These survey nV(h) nail forms match that regional series, with no retained velar. They are distinguished from the separate *nakkha branch and from compound or expanded responses.
